name: @finapp/m15-recon
description: M15 — bank reconciliation: multi-bank accounts, statement + ledger ingestion (CSV/Excel/PDF, duplicate-protected), reconciliation runs, the deterministic matching engine (via m15a) with confidence bands + colour status, 1:1/1:many/many:1/split/grouped matches, exception management + aging, manual review/override, explainable evidence and run summaries. Money is integer minor units — never float. Owns no chart of accounts (m19), GL reconciliation (m20), journals/postings (m21), approvals (m22).
